svg.text: User features derived from the HTTP routes in src/web/routes and the application use cases in src/<module>/application
EscolaViva system — multi-tenant school SaaS platform
Access and account — any authenticated user

g.text: Association — the actor performs the use case
Generalisation — every role is an authenticated user
«include» — behaviour always executed by the base case
«extend» — optional behaviour that extends the base case
Dashed ellipse = included/extended use case, never started directly by the actor.

svg.text: Every use case happens inside a network: the network_id in
the session scopes what each role sees. Roles are assigned
per school — the same person can be a registrar at one
school and a guardian at another, and requireRole() only
checks that the role exists, not which records it covers.
Publish announcement and Track reads are the only two cases
